name: Season podium (a member's)
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-podium: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to its participants, its season admins and platform admins (season_visible), and to anyone else exactly as the public route does. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. The podium the close froze (season_podium), first to third on each ladder: one place per owner, each owner's best version standing for them, baselines skipped. Each place carries its owner's newest counted match of that season to watch (match_ref_json), read backwards off the owner's versions' rating_events. season_cache: a closed podium never changes. Read, never re-ranked: the podium of a closed season is what it closed on. A live season answers with no ladders. 404 for an unknown game or season.
